Lines 5, 7 and 16b: the second filters the per-person sums by the qualifying predicate, the project sums per-person amounts that are zero for anyone who does not qualify (equal in value). Line 13: the project subtracts a Credit Limit Worksheet B amount that is zero in the slice (equal in value). Line 16a: subtract_floor0 against subtract, equal because line 14 is the smaller of line 12 and line 13. Line 18a: the second adds line 18b and applies the worksheet's zero stop; both are zero in the slice (combat pay refused; the stop makes no difference to a sum of non-negative lines). Line 18b: the second asks for combat pay behind the same flag the project refuses on (scope). Line 21: the second sums the Medicare box 6 totals directly where the project reads Form 8959 line 19, which is that sum (equal in value). Line 27: the second carries the Puerto Rico condition in the guard, the project refuses it (scope). No change to the data.
